caption: The image is a drawing depicting a dark-colored wooden doll with jointed arms and legs. The doll stands upright, facing forward, with its arms hanging down at its sides. It has an oval-shaped head with defined facial features including large eyes, a carved nose, and a small mouth. The doll wears a brown hat with a darker brim, and its body is accentuated with red lines, including details on its chest, waist, and around its boots. The boots are black with red tops, matching the other red accents on the doll’s torso. The background is plain and beige, with a faint rectangular border drawn around the doll, centering it on the page. The drawing is signed "MIYA LOWRY" in small letters at the bottom left corner.
title: Dancing Doll
